name: iCapital

web.notes: Advisor/wealth-manager platform; end investors typically reach iCapital via their advisor's instance or custodian SSO. MFA methods not confirmed from public docs.

api.notes: No public developer portal, API reference or OpenAPI contract. Third-party catalog (API Evangelist, profiled 2026-08-01) states API documentation is available to integration partners only via sales/technical support. iCapital Data Management (ex-AltExchange/Mirador) delivers data to custodians and reporting vendors (BridgeFT partnership 2025) but transport (API vs SFTP) is not publicly documented.

mcp.notes: No iCapital MCP server found in the official MCP registry or GitHub as of 2026-11-07. April 2026 Anthropic partnership embeds Claude inside iCapital's platform; no MCP endpoint announced. A third-party Truthifi connector claims to link iCapital accounts to Claude (not vendor-maintained).

sftp.notes: iCapital Data Management advertises delivery 'to any downstream reporting system'; SFTP not confirmed.

email_notifications.notes: Capital call/distribution notifications via platform; details not public.

notes: Confidence: high that no public/self-serve API exists (API Evangelist probe 2026-08/10: no dev portal, /openapi.json 404). Medium confidence that a partner API and a data-management feed exist (press releases: BridgeFT 2025, AltExchange acquisition 2024; Sacra analysis). Terms of Service s.7.1 prohibit 'any automated system (excluding authorized APIs)' and 'spiders, robots, avatars or intelligent agents', and require access 'through the interface provided by iCapital'; s.3.1 forbids sharing credentials, s.3.2 allows designated Authorized Users (employees, advisors, agents). MFA method on web login not confirmed. Investor-side API: none found.

terms.notes: ToS 7.1(iv),(v),(viii) bar automated access and intelligent agents except 'authorized APIs'. Authorized Users (advisors/agents) may be designated under 3.2.
